name: Sakashita Yoshiyuki
source:
Extremely selfish and true to his desires, he will eliminate anybody who gets in the way. 

Perhaps because he's an orphan and had no parents, he grew up with a philosophy of "I have to enjoy myself". His attitude towards everything is generally pretty positive. 

He always gives higher precedence for things he wants to do while going to school.

His grades aren't very good and people school-wide generally treat him like a bad student or a delinquent.

Emotionally, he tends to treats both anger and sadness logically. In contrast to that, he expresses positive emotions straight out. 

He is especially honest with his sexual desire as the adult woman there have very attractive body that the other students simply don't have. 

He is especially interested in the bodies of his female teachers. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/pod/manual/index.html]Bishop's Character Descriptions[/url]]

The protagonist was unjustly suspended from school prior to the start of the story. He has the ability to tell a girl's exact Breast and Cup Size just by looking.
